id: 46_What types of training are required for laboratory staff laboratory microbiology
title: 进生物实验室要学什么
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/46_What types of training are required for laboratory staff laboratory microbiology.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/46_What types of training are required for laboratory staff laboratory microbiology/src.py

points.K2: 生物安全操作：操作、隔离、废物
points.K3: 生物安保意识：防止未经授权接触
points.K4: 个人防护：会选、会穿、会脱
points.K5: 应急程序：溢洒、撤离、暴露处理
points.K6: 设备使用：安全柜、灭菌器
points.K7: 事件报告：怎么报，何时报
points.S1: 培训分三层：学校、学院、实验室
points.S2: 能力看实操：做一遍给带教人看
points.S3: 换项目、用新设备：补专项培训

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在培训教室门口，手里拿着一本空白手册
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a small training classroom holding a blank handbook and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：进生物实验室要学什么。
overlay: 进生物实验室要学什么

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着准入考试合格的空白证书，兴奋地走向实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student happily walks toward the lab holding a blank certificate card.
shots.narration: 阿杰通过了学校的安全考试，想直接上手。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研笑着拦住，翻开一张六格清单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles, stops him and opens a blank checklist with six boxes.
shots.narration: 小研说：要做微生物实验，还有六门课。

shots.section_title: 六类必备培训
shots.scene: 六个图标排成两行
shots.prompt_en: Six icons in two rows: a petri dish, a padlock, gloves, a warning triangle, a biosafety cabinet and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室人员的必备培训，有六类。

shots.section_title: 六类必备培训
shots.scene: 第六个电话图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The telephone icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 最后一类，是事件报告。

shots.section_title: 培训分三层：学校、学院、实验室
shots.scene: 三层台阶：学校楼、学院楼、实验室门，各有讲台图标
shots.prompt_en: A three-level diagram: a university building, a department building and a lab door, each with a small podium icon. No people.
shots.narration: 培训分三层，一层比一层具体。
overlay: 培训分三层：学校、学院、实验室

shots.section_title: 培训分三层：学校、学院、实验室
shots.scene: 王老师在学院教室给一群学生讲课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a group of students in a department classroom with a blank screen.
shots.narration: 学校通识考试之后，学院开生物安全专项课，

shots.section_title: 培训分三层：学校、学院、实验室
shots.scene: 老周在实验室里给阿杰讲本组的规程
shots.prompt_en: The older man explains the group's blank procedure binder to the young male student in the lab.
shots.narration: 最后在实验室，学本岗位、本课题的规程。

shots.section_title: 生物安全操作：操作、隔离、废物
shots.scene: 培养皿图标亮起，小研戴手套演示
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves and a lab coat, demonstrates careful handling of a culture plate.
shots.narration: 第一，生物安全操作。
overlay: 生物安全操作：操作、隔离、废物

shots.section_title: 生物安全操作：操作、隔离、废物
shots.scene: 小研在安全柜里操作，阿杰在旁观看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works inside a biosafety cabinet while the young male student watches.
shots.narration: 学会规范操作，在防护设施里做实验，

shots.section_title: 生物安全操作：操作、隔离、废物
shots.scene: 废弃培养物装袋，放入灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: Used culture plates go into a biohazard bag and then into an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 还要学会废物怎样灭活、怎样处置。

shots.section_title: 生物安保意识：防止未经授权接触
shots.scene: 带锁的样本冰箱和门禁读卡器
shots.prompt_en: A locked sample freezer and a door access card reader. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，生物安保意识。
overlay: 生物安保意识：防止未经授权接触

shots.section_title: 生物安保意识：防止未经授权接触
shots.scene: 一个陌生人形图标在门外，被门禁挡住
shots.prompt_en: An unfamiliar person silhouette icon is stopped at a locked lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 能认出未经授权的进入和接触，

shots.section_title: 生物安保意识：防止未经授权接触
shots.scene: 阿杰在空白登记本上签字领取样本
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank logbook before taking a sample box from the freezer.
shots.narration: 样本领用要登记，钥匙门卡不外借。

shots.section_title: 个人防护：会选、会穿、会脱
shots.scene: 手套、护目镜、实验服、口罩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of gloves, goggles, a lab coat and a respirator mask. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，个人防护装备。
overlay: 个人防护：会选、会穿、会脱

shots.section_title: 个人防护：会选、会穿、会脱
shots.scene: 小研对照空白清单挑选合适尺码的手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks gloves of the right size from a shelf, checking a blank list.
shots.narration: 按风险评估选对防护用品，

shots.section_title: 个人防护：会选、会穿、会脱
shots.scene: 阿杰按顺序穿上实验服、戴手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on a lab coat and then gloves in front of a mirror.
shots.narration: 按顺序穿戴，检查是否完好，

shots.section_title: 个人防护：会选、会穿、会脱
shots.scene: 阿杰摘手套时外面朝里翻
shots.prompt_en: The young male student removes his gloves by turning them inside out.
shots.narration: 脱的时候外面当污染，别碰到皮肤。

shots.section_title: 应急程序：溢洒、撤离、暴露处理
shots.scene: 警示三角图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 第四，应急程序。
overlay: 应急程序：溢洒、撤离、暴露处理

shots.section_title: 应急程序：溢洒、撤离、暴露处理
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰用空白溢洒处理箱演练
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student practice with a spill kit around a blank prop spill.
shots.narration: 溢洒了怎么处理，

shots.section_title: 应急程序：溢洒、撤离、暴露处理
shots.scene: 绿色疏散指示标志和向外走的箭头
shots.prompt_en: An emergency exit sign with green arrows pointing toward the door. No people.
shots.narration: 什么情况要撤离，

shots.section_title: 应急程序：溢洒、撤离、暴露处理
shots.scene: 洗眼器和急救箱图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an eyewash station and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 被扎伤、溅到了，第一时间怎么做。

shots.section_title: 设备使用：安全柜、灭菌器
shots.scene: 安全柜和高压灭菌器并排
shots.prompt_en: A biosafety cabinet and an autoclave side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 第五，设备使用。
overlay: 设备使用：安全柜、灭菌器

shots.section_title: 设备使用：安全柜、灭菌器
shots.scene: 老李给阿杰讲安全柜面板，面板只有图标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer explains the icon-only control panel of a biosafety cabinet to the young male student.
shots.narration: 安全柜怎么开、怎么用、怎么判断正常，

shots.section_title: 设备使用：安全柜、灭菌器
shots.scene: 老李在灭菌器前演示关门锁紧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer demonstrates closing and locking the autoclave door.
shots.narration: 灭菌器怎么装载、怎么防烫伤。

shots.section_title: 换项目、用新设备：补专项培训
shots.scene: 阿杰面前出现一台新设备和一个新微生物图标
shots.prompt_en: A new instrument and a new microbe icon with a star appear in front of the young male student.
shots.narration: 学过一次，不等于什么都会了。
overlay: 换项目、用新设备：补专项培训

shots.section_title: 换项目、用新设备：补专项培训
shots.scene: 三个触发图标：新课题、新设备、新版规程
shots.prompt_en: Three trigger icons: a new project folder, a new instrument and a binder with a new page. No people.
shots.narration: 换课题、用新设备、规程改版，

shots.section_title: 换项目、用新设备：补专项培训
shots.scene: 老周给阿杰补讲，阿杰在空白培训记录上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man gives the young male student extra instruction; he signs a blank training record.
shots.narration: 都要补专项培训，再上手。

shots.section_title: 事件报告：怎么报，何时报
shots.scene: 电话图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 第六，事件报告。
overlay: 事件报告：怎么报，何时报

shots.section_title: 事件报告：怎么报，何时报
shots.scene: 报告链：实验室门→学院楼→学校楼和保卫处
shots.prompt_en: A reporting chain of arrows: a lab door, then a department building, then a university building and a security office. No people.
shots.narration: 要知道向谁报：实验室负责人、学院、学校。

shots.section_title: 事件报告：怎么报，何时报
shots.scene: 时钟图标，指针刚走一点
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon with the hand just moving forward. No people.
shots.narration: 事故和暴露，发生后立即报告，

shots.section_title: 事件报告：怎么报，何时报
shots.scene: 小研在空白事件记录表上如实填写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills in a blank incident record form.
shots.narration: 如实记录，配合后续随访。

shots.section_title: 能力看实操：做一遍给带教人看
shots.scene: 阿杰在安全柜前独立操作，小研拿着空白检查表看着
shots.prompt_en: The young male student works alone at the biosafety cabinet while the female graduate student watches with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 学完了，还要做一遍给带教人看。
overlay: 能力看实操：做一遍给带教人看

shots.section_title: 能力看实操：做一遍给带教人看
shots.scene: 检查表上逐项打勾，一项打叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with several green checks and one red X. No people.
shots.narration: 哪一步不到位，当场纠正，再练。

shots.section_title: 能力看实操：做一遍给带教人看
shots.scene: 小研在检查表底部签名，阿杰点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student signs the bottom of the checklist; the young male student nods.
shots.narration: 确认会了，才能独立操作。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣站在六个图标旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the six training icons.
shots.narration: 安全操作、安保、防护、应急、设备、报告。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 三层台阶图示
shots.prompt_en: The three-level training diagram. No people.
shots.narration: 学校、学院、实验室，三层培训。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 检查表与签名
shots.prompt_en: A checklist with a signature line. No people.
shots.narration: 会不会，看实操。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 新设备和新微生物图标
shots.prompt_en: A new instrument and a new microbe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有新变化，补培训。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰站在实验室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye at the lab door with a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 学到位，再上手，下次见！
